mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements about priority sector lending (PSL) targets: 1. The overall PSL target for domestic banks is 40% of Adjusted Net Bank Credit (ANBC). 2. The agriculture target is 18% of ANBC, of which 14% is earmarked for small and marginal farmers. 3. The overall PSL target for Regional Rural Banks is 75% of ANBC. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq_fix.why: RBI cut SFB overall PSL target to 60% (June 2025, from FY 2025-26); keep statement 3 true for RRBs only
